title: .a11yrc.json
description: Project configuration for the a11y-skills audit toolkit (DESIGN.md section 8)

rulePacks.description: Which rule packs are active, e.g. "react", "fluent-ui", "pcf-dataverse"

profile.description: Compliance profile driving Layer 0 content and Layer 1-3 severity mapping (DESIGN.md section 2.3b)

wcagVersion.description: WCAG version to audit against; rules first introduced in a later version are excluded

overrides.description: Per-rule severity overrides, keyed by ruleId. Rules mapped to the four non-interference criteria (1.4.2, 2.1.2, 2.2.2, 2.3.1) ignore relaxing overrides.

processes.description: Named multi-page processes for WCAG 5.2.3 process-level conformance grouping; each value is the list of page URLs/paths in the flow

hooksEnabled.description: Opt-in switch for the Claude Code UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse enforcement hooks (DESIGN.md section 2.3d). Set by `a11y init --with-hooks`; the hook scripts check this field themselves and no-op when false/absent, since Claude Code plugin hooks are otherwise always registered once the plugin is installed.
